name: Flag the Bombs
description: A crisp take on the mine-clearing classic. Pick easy, medium or hard, open cells with the left button, mark suspected bombs with the right one, and use number chording to sweep the board quickly. Keeps your fastest time for each size and remembers a game in progress. Plays entirely offline with no accounts, no ads and no data collection.

browser_action.default_title: Flag the Bombs — Logic, nerve, and a very small grid
